title: Multi-turn ACP session context & bounded replay in susi-core plus vendor/a2a dead-code pruning and susi-gawd-a2a ceiling ratchet
goal: Upgrade Susi Core's Apache-2.0 ACP open-socket pillar (`crates/susi-core/src/acp.rs`) so ACP sessions (`session/new`, `session/prompt`, `session/load`, `session/history`, `session/cancel`) maintain bounded multi-turn conversation message history (`role`, `content`, `turn_id`, `tool_calls` metadata, per-session message cap and byte budget ring buffer, cursor replay, and HTTP `acp-session-id` header binding/spoofing rejection) and return structured multi-turn `messages` / `inference_messages` context for downstream inference and commercial ACP plugs; prune 77 production lines of unreferenced dead helpers across `susi-vendor-tempfile`, `susi-vendor-wasmtime`, and `susi-gawd-a2a::TaskStore::delete`; move `susi-gawd-a2a`'s unchanged `executor.rs` inline unit suite to `src/tests/executor.rs`; and ratchet `susi-gawd-a2a` ceiling strictly down (-175 lines, 3,588 -> 3,413) in `tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs` and `docs/lean-core.md`.
limitations: ACP multi-turn session history is bounded in-memory per AcpEngine instance (`DEFAULT_MAX_HISTORY_MESSAGES = 64`, `DEFAULT_MAX_HISTORY_BYTES = 524_288`); persistent multi-tenant session storage belongs in susi-commercial-apps.
